source.license_access_terms: NOAA IBTrACS metadata: redistribution/use without restriction; cite Gahtan et al. 2024, DOI 10.25921/82ty-9e16 and Knapp et al. 2010. NOAA ERDDAP official license metadata verified.
transformation_history: Unmodified public download; stored separately from original raw collection.

target: Count of distinct MAIN SIDs with a North Indian basin tropical (NATURE=TS) record, assigned to their first such month. Includes tropical depressions; no wind threshold or landfall definition.
zeros: Explicit zero eligible archived storm IDs in an included calendar month. Not verified absence of all cyclones/disasters.
excluded: Pre-1980, 2025/2026 incomplete/provisional years, non-main tracks, non-NI positions, non-TS positions. First qualifying month determined before date filtering to avoid counting cross-year storms twice.
geography: NI basin, not Indian political territory or district landfalls.
